title: Tere Mehmaan aaye hai shiree\'n
body:
Tere Mehmaan aaye hai shiree\'n
HAYE AFSOS TU NA PEHCHANI ..(4)
KARARBALA SE LUTE LUTAAY HUEY TERE MEHMAAN AAYE HAI SHEERIN
APNA WADA NIBHANE NIZO PER KHUCH MUSALMAAN AAYE HAIN SHEERIN
<<DIVIDER>>
GHAR  SAJA APNA BE GHARO’N KE LEYE, CHADAREN LAKE DE SARON KE LEYE
SAR PE GHURBAT KI DHOOB ODHEY HUEY  SAB  PARESHAAN AAYE HAIN SHEERIN
EK KAATE SAR SE AARAHI THI SADA, TERE AAQA KE PAAS KUCH NA BACHA
KOI TOHFA NA LAAYE TERE LEYE HUM PASHEMAAN AAYE HAI N SHEERIN
<<DIVIDER>>
TERA GHAR AUR KAHAN RASOOL KI AAL,KAR NABI ZADIYON KA ISTEQBAL
AAJ TERE GHARIB KHANE PER DEE’N KE SULTAN AAYE HAIN SHEERIN
WHO JO ATHAHRA SAAL KA SAR HAI, UMME LAILA KE LAAL KA SAR HAI
MAA KE HUMRAH KHOON ME GHAILTA’N  MAA KE ARMAAN AAYE  HAIN SHEERIN
<<DIVIDER>>
SHEH KA GHUNCHA DAHEN BHI AAYA HAI,QASIM E GUL BADAN BHI AAYA HAI
DEKH APNE LAHOO ME DOOB E HUEY KITNE QURAAN  AAYE HAIN SHEERIN
SAATH ABBAS E NAAMDAR BHI HAI,TERE AAQA KE  JAANISAR BHI HAI
RAAH TAKTI THI JINKI KHUWABO’N ME  LE WOH INSAAN AAYE HAIN SHEERIN
<<DIVIDER>>
KYA KAHE DASTAN E BARBADI, RO KE KAHTI THI HAR NABI ZADI
KHOKE APNA MUSAFERAT ME SABHI SAZO SAMAAN AAYE HAIN SHEERIN
HAI KAHAN AB DIL E BATOOL KO CHAIN, LUT GAYI RAN ME KAIYENAAT E HUSSAIN
BANN KE SAJJAD APNE BABA KE MARSIYA KHUWAAN  AAYE HAIN SHEERIN
<<DIVIDER>>
DIL LARAZTA HAI AAMIR O AKHTAR,JAB YEH KAHTI ‘N THI ZAINAB E MUZTAR
BE RIDAYI ME SHAHRE KHUFA KE RASTE CHAAN AAYE HAIN SHEERIN
